args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks after it was deployed to production. It was marked unhealthy with an 18% error rate in us-east, us-west and eu-west. The v2.3.1-rc build was also unhealthy in staging. Action taken: rolled checkout-api back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Follow-up: confirm health and error rate have recovered on v2.3.0, and find the root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident.

- **Problem:** The latest release, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. It's now running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. A status check after the rollback shows it healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2) is open, and the on-call engineer has been paged. It describes the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0 and the follow-ups: keep watching v2.3.0, and find what's wrong in v2.3.1 before deploying it again.
